entities.summary: Kuo Yi-hang formerly Kuo Shu-fen is a female weightlifter who competed for Chinese Taipei in the 2000 Summer Olympics and won a bronze medal in heavyweight category. She lifted a total of 245 kg at bodyweight of 75 kg.
